lines: A sign on the buoy reads:
The Dragon Sea was written by Sattanos for exclusive use on
Carrion Fields.  Any use of this area is strictly forbidden without
The sea has many creatures who will leave you alone as long
as you leave them alone.  The ships which sail the waves will
welcome those who ask, "Permission to come aboard?" and
hold a symbol the captain can recognize.
Many thanks to the patience and creativity of Vassagon who put
the wind in the sails of the ships.
Loop back in a confusing but consistent manner
M - The mouth of the river (Hamsah map)
O - The Open Sea (with an exit down)
1 - North from beneath links to here.
e - South one way as expected to Beneath the Waves
^ - Beneath the Waves (up only) (Or one way north to Open Sea)
x - Beneath the Waves (Up and down)
* Rollup a stormie and test all links, finish Two levels down (The Depths)
